prompt_en: A complex photographic test scene centers on a human subject in one observable moment at the indoor lost-property counter of a city public swimming pool. She is a clearly adult 29-year-old woman with the visible face and hair appearance supplied in the attached image, wearing a dry slate-blue rain jacket over a plain ivory crew-neck top. A folded floor guide lies open on the counter with its printed arrow pointing left, while a simple wall wayfinding arrow behind her points right; numbered locker-key tags and a rolled swimming cap in a shallow tray establish the public-pool desk. She has paused between comparing those two directions. Her head is nearly frontal with a slight tilt, and both eyes remain visibly open. The upper eyelids are partially lowered, with her subject-left upper lid visibly lower than her subject-right, while both pupils remain visible. Their upper margins cover the tops of both irises, while the lower lids stay broadly open below this unequal upper-lid lowering. Both irises shift toward her own right, screen left. Her lips are parted by a narrow central gap showing a thin upper-incisor edge, and her subject-left mouth corner sits subtly higher than her subject-right. Her right index fingertip presses her own right lower cheek just beside the mouth, making a small visible indentation; the other right fingers curl naturally below it. Her left index fingertip hovers beside her own left temple with a clearly visible five-centimeter air gap, and the left hand remains separate from her hair. Both elbows are bent freely in front of her torso, with continuous forearms leading to their respective hands. Her left temple-level hand sits higher than her right cheek-level hand relative to her upright torso, each wrist following its own forearm. Make an eye-height waist-up environmental portrait with both hands and her full head in frame, enough facial detail to separate eyelid edges, tooth edge, and finger contact. Soft window fill balances neutral overhead room light, giving the face delicate local contrast while pale tile seams and the two arrows stay legible. The restrained off-center composition gives her small asymmetries an intimate everyday presence within an ordinary public errand.
